_source: Display metadata for the localhost book-template-picker. Ported from layout-gen/layout-templates-web (app/page.tsx) and merged with the renderer's canonical fields (aspect_ratio, canvas, content_type, best_ref) from seed/template-references/manifest.json. The picker reads THIS file for the gallery; the renderer reads seed/template-references/manifest.json. Template ids MUST stay identical across both.

observations.title: Top-Left is King
observations.desc: Text over full-bleed illustrations goes top-left most often. The sky area there is painted lighter for legibility.

observations.title: Sky = Text Zone
observations.desc: Clouds, open sky, distant horizon — deliberately simpler and lighter, reserved for text placement.

observations.title: Never Over Faces
observations.desc: Text never overlaps character faces or key action. Universal across every reference.

observations.title: Style Travels
observations.desc: The page inherits IMAGE 2's exact characters, palette and rendering — photoreal stays photoreal, 2D stays 2D.

observations.title: 70% Don't Wrap
observations.desc: Most pages use clean rectangular text blocks in pre-planned zones. Wrapping is mostly for educational spots.

observations.title: Designed-In Zones
observations.desc: Quiet text zones are part of the illustration from the start — never added afterwards.

templates.name: Full-Bleed with Text Zone
templates.nickname: The immersive scene with built-in breathing room
templates.description: Illustration fills the entire page edge-to-edge. Text (2–6 lines) sits in the top 20–30%, over a deliberately lighter area — sky, clouds, horizon, or a plain wall painted simpler and lighter.

templates.name: Vignette on Page
templates.nickname: Soft-edged illustration floating on a clean page
templates.description: A vignette with soft faded edges floats on a cream/white page, covering 40–65% of the area. Text fills the remaining space above, below, or beside it. Ideal for gentle, intimate moments.

templates.name: Split Layout
templates.nickname: Illustration one side, text the other
templates.description: The page splits into two zones — one side is primarily illustration, the other primarily text on a lighter background. Split is 50/50 or 60/40, with an organic transition rather than a hard cut.

templates.name: Scattered Spots
templates.nickname: Sticker-like illustrations with text in the gaps
templates.description: Multiple small spot illustrations scattered across a white page like stickers. Text blocks fill the gaps; labels and callouts point to details. Each spot is isolated with no background.

templates.name: Full Spread, No Text
templates.nickname: Pure visual storytelling — edge to edge
templates.description: The illustration spans the full spread with NO text at all. Used for dramatic moments, emotional beats, or wordless visual storytelling. The most cinematic layout.

templates.name: Illustrated Border
templates.nickname: Illustration frames the page, text fills the center
templates.description: The illustration forms a frame around the page edges — foliage, vines, architecture, stone walls. Text fills the center, surrounded by the illustrated frame. Great for spiritual or poetic content.

templates.name: Character Text Pocket
templates.nickname: A character's pose creates negative space for text
templates.description: A large character or object is posed so its body carves out a natural white pocket. Text fills this pocket; the character's shape defines the text boundary.

templates.name: Connected Infographic
templates.nickname: One connected diagram with room for labels all around
templates.description: A single connected scene or diagram sits in the center, showing related concepts in one unified composition. White space surrounds it on all sides for text, labels, and callouts. Perfect for science diagrams.

templates.name: Spread: Scene + Spots
templates.nickname: Full-bleed scene on the left, scattered vignettes on the right
templates.description: A spread where the left page is a full-bleed immersive scene and the right page carries 3–5 small spot vignettes on white. Text fills the gaps on the right. Combines storytelling with detail moments.
templates.imageBg: Left opaque, right spots on white
